question: how do i join SGA
answer:
The Student Government Association says you can join a committee by emailing sga@ramapo.edu; all Ramapo students are able and encouraged to join. Committee meetings are scheduled at each chair’s discretion. [2]
You can also come to a General Meeting or stop by the SGA office, SC-225, to learn more. [1] Senate meetings are Mondays at 7pm in ASB 230; General Meetings are Wednesdays at 1 pm, with locations varying. Both are open to the public. [3] Weekly meetings are open to everyone on campus. [8]
For SGA positions, look in the Daily Digest for announcements about openings. Full-year elections are held every April, but students can become SGA members at any time. [7]
Contact SGA at sga@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7271, or visit SC-225. [1]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/sga/faq/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/sga/getting-involved/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/sga/meetings/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/leadership-directory/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/student-government-association-sga/)
